description: A deploy-event step in the preview job (no deployment job) is rejected.

patches.find: # task.uploadsummary is not allowed in restricted mode; this step prints only the fixed
patches.replace:
- task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: Report
            condition: succeededOrFailed()
            continueOnError: true
            timeoutInMinutes: 5
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: sc-${{ parameters.app.slug }}-${{ parameters.environment.name }}
              scriptType: bash
              scriptLocation: scriptPath
              scriptPath: $(Pipeline.Workspace)/s/core/pipelines/azure-devops/scripts/report.sh
            target:
              commands: restricted
          # task.uploadsummary is not allowed in restricted mode; this step prints only the fixed
